verdicts.note: The tenant-protection items (rent stabilization, just-cause eviction, right to counsel) come only from the primary dossier [S2]; her current platform pairs a 1,000-unit affordable target via public land and nonprofits [S3] with support for the mayor's 'Taller Denser Faster' upzoning ('We should let people live next to it') [S7], a market-supply position. Net +1, not the full public-housing pole.

Direction stands (CARE Department, community court, opposes SOAP and CCTV [S3][S5]), but the same sources record 'I support 1,200 police', hiring detectives and a supplementary North Seattle precinct [S5][S6]. Evidence points both ways, so high confidence is overstated.
